A introduces NewFileWithFields and unrelated multipart association machinery.","A adds WithFileDealID, WithFilePersonID, and other association fields despite the contract explicitly forbidding association fields.","A's Upload calls Raw.Do directly and duplicates Add's request/response logic. B at least centralizes both paths in the same add helper, though it still does not literally call Add as required by the contract undefined behavior delegated method call should be there? Still materially closer than A's separate implementation. (Note: avoid weird phrase) B centralizes behavior; A outright duplicates it plus options machinery. Need valid polished JSON."],"risks_a":["Upload has the wrong public option type and changes existing option return types, creating unnecessary API churn.","The broad RawClient seek/replay and ownership changes affect Files.Update, Persons.AddPicture, and arbitrary reader requests outside the requested scope.","Seek-based GetBody mutates one shared reader and could be fragile if request-body recreation is invoked concurrently or unexpectedly multiple times."],"risks_b":["Upload does not literally route through FilesService.Add; both call a new private add helper, contrary to the explicit contract.","Add now buffers every caller-provided custom body, changing its streaming and reader-error behavior despite the requirement to preserve Add behavior.","Tests omit explicit empty-filename, nil-content, and source-reader-error coverage, and combine the two validation errors into one message."]}
